info.title: Focus Assistant API
info.description: Session management and research data. Observed activity, heuristic estimates, and self-reports are separate.

get.summary: Summarize observed activity, estimates, goals, and self-reports in a date range.
Return calendar day, ISO week, or month buckets in the requested IANA time zone.
Page through comparable per-session research measures.

post.summary: Create an account and return its public profile.
Exchange account credentials for access and refresh tokens.
Rotate a refresh token and revoke the previous token pair.
Revoke the current login and its refresh token.

patch.summary: Update the authenticated account's display name.

post.summary: Change the password and revoke all account logins.

get.summary: Read the current account's telemetry consent.

patch.summary: Enable or disable server-side telemetry acceptance.

get.summary: Read the account privacy export and links to pageable records.

post.summary: Verify the account password and delete the account and its owned data.
Store aggregate intervals and versioned estimates atomically, with retry deduplication.

get.summary: Page through observed aggregate windows in chronological order.
Page through heuristic estimates in chronological order.
Read the latest available estimate, session status, and goals for an owned session.
Read lifecycle timestamps, goals, and a page of chronological interval references.

post.summary: Create a planned session with optional goals and an owned work profile.

get.summary: Page through owned sessions by start or creation time.
Read one owned session with durations, ratings, and goal statistics.

post.summary: Record the beginning of a pause in an active session.
End the active pause and resume work.
Cancel a planned, active, or paused session.
Finish a started session and atomically record ratings and goal outcomes.

get.summary: List goals attached to an owned session.

post.summary: Add a goal to a planned session.

get.summary: Read a goal by its ID within an owned session.

patch.summary: Edit a planned goal description or record a started goal's outcome.

delete.summary: Remove a goal from a planned session.

get.summary: Read persisted Pomodoro preferences or the defaults.

put.summary: Replace the authenticated account's Pomodoro preferences.

get.summary: Read persisted avatar preferences or the defaults.

put.summary: Replace the authenticated account's avatar preferences.

get.summary: Page through the account's work profiles and process rules.

post.summary: Create a work profile and optional process rules.

get.summary: Read one owned work profile and its process rules.

put.summary: Replace an owned work profile and its process rules.

delete.summary: Delete an unused profile. Sessions retain their profile references.

Bearer.description: Use the access token from login or refresh in the Authorization header.
